analysis_status: exploratory descriptive reanalysis of published experimental records
block_interpretation: Ranges across eight contiguous, internally recentered blocks are descriptive sensitivity checks, not confidence intervals or independent replicates.

harmwell_n1.h5.interpretation: Plug-in margins, not simultaneous confidence bounds; negative margins alone do not reject reversibility.

harmwell_n1_groundtruth.h5.interpretation: Plug-in margins, not simultaneous confidence bounds; negative margins alone do not reject reversibility.

harmwell_n2.h5.interpretation: Plug-in margins, not simultaneous confidence bounds; negative margins alone do not reject reversibility.

unit_gain_independent_noise_variance_dec.interpretation: Conditional on unit gains and mutually independent additive detector errors independent of particle; not a calibrated noise estimate.

exposure_note: Simultaneous detectors share one physical exposure; overlapping lag pairs and adjacent blocks are dependent. Separate n2 record has undocumented alignment to n1.
protocol_note: Split and lag grid fixed before new correlation calculations; whole-file descriptive statistics and sources had already been inspected, so this is not prospectively blinded validation.

reasons: No independently established hidden-process dependence bound
No uniform detector memory or conditional-independence calibration
Population Markov/reversal and physical entropy scope remain assumptions

training_ou_model.interpretation: Naive single-exponential covariance fit on training data; not a mixing or thermodynamic calibration.
